question: Which cricketer was honoured with Padma Shri in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravichandran Ashwin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ravichandran Ashwin** is one of India’s most celebrated cricketers, known for his exceptional skills as an all-rounder, primarily excelling as an off-spin bowler.
 
• In **2025**, he was awarded the **Padma Shri**, India’s fourth-highest civilian award, for his outstanding contribution to Indian cricket.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is awarded to individuals who demonstrate excellence in their respective fields, including sports, arts, literature, science, and public service.
 
• Ravichandran Ashwin has been a crucial player for the Indian cricket team, with significant achievements such as being one of the fastest bowlers to reach **400 wickets** in Test cricket.
 
• He has also contributed significantly with the bat, scoring multiple centuries in Test matches, showcasing his versatility as an all-rounder.
 
• His tactical brilliance and ability to perform under pressure have made him a cornerstone of the Indian cricket team, both in domestic and international formats.
